approved.en: Ukraine is using naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya's Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO's chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports that Russia is preparing a nuclear satellite launch, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. North Korea has halted military aid to Russia, according to Ukrainian intelligence. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

NATO-sjefen har lovet forsvar mot en russisk romtrussel etter rapporter om at Russland forbereder en oppskyting av en atomisk satellitt, og MI5 har advart britiske firmaer som leverer til Ukraina om sabotasje­risiko. FNs sikkerhetsråd advarte om at vinterangrep på Ukrainas strømnett og skipsfarten i Svartehavet truer liv og verdens matforsyninger. approved.en: Somali militants attacked an Ethiopian base, killing 43 soldiers, while Ethiopian forces engaged Eritrean-backed fighters in Gemalo near Badme and shelled Alamata, killing 14 civilians, according to Amnesty. Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed warned Eritrea to cease support for Ethiopia's enemies or face destruction, and reiterated Ethiopia will not invade Eritrea, while also reaffirming a commitment to Horn of Africa peace. Kenyan trucks were escorted across the volatile Moyale border and Ethiopian troops resumed flights to Aksum, as MPs raised alarms over civilian killings and displacement across Amhara, Oromia, Tigray and other regions. The conflict produced 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Etiopias statsminister Abiy Ahmed advarte Eritrea om å stoppe støtten til Etiopias fiender eller risikere ødeleggelse, og gjentok at Etiopia ikke vil invadere Eritrea, samtidig som han bekreftet en forpliktelse til fred i Afrikas horn. Kenianske lastebiler ble eskortert over den ustabile Moyale-grensen, og etiopiske tropper gjenopptok flyvninger til Aksum, mens parlamentarikere varslet om sivile drap og fordrivelse i Amhara, Oromia, Tigray og andre regioner. Konflikten førte til 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
